title: Compatible maps from a prelog presheaf extend uniquely through its sheafified unit pushout
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. On its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $M$ be a presheaf of commutative monoids (a contravariant functor with monoid-homomorphism restrictions) and $\gamma:M\to(\mathcal O_X,\cdot)$ a natural monoid homomorphism. For each etale $V\to X$, put $B_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, $E_V=\gamma_V^{-1}(B_V^\times)$, and let $P(V)$ be the commutative-monoid quotient of $M(V)\times B_V^\times$ by the congruence generated by $(me,u)\sim(m,\gamma_V(e)u)$ for $e\in E_V$.

Let $L$ be a log structure [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], let $\eta:P\to L$ exhibit $L$ as the commutative-monoid sheafification of $P$ [lem-trf-commutative-monoid-sheafification], and suppose $\alpha_L\eta_V([m,u])=\gamma_V(m)u$. Put $i_V(m)=\eta_V([m,1])$ and $j_V(u)=\eta_V([1,u])$. For every log structure $K$ on $X$, let $j_K:\mathcal O_X^\times\to K$ be the inverse of its units isomorphism. Composition with $i$ is a bijection from monoid-sheaf homomorphisms $f:L\to K$ satisfying $\alpha_K f=\alpha_L$ to natural monoid homomorphisms $v:M\to K$ satisfying $\alpha_Kv=\gamma$. Its inverse is the unique extension through $\eta$ of the natural homomorphism $P\to K$ given by $[m,u]\mapsto v_V(m)j_{K,V}(u)$. Every such $f$ automatically satisfies $f j=j_K$.

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-log-unit-section-lift] for K to obtain unique lifts j(U,a) of all ring unit sections. The lift of 1 is 1, and the lift of ab is j(U,a)j(U,b), since the structural map is monoidal. This constructs the monoid homomorphisms jK. Naturality of α_K and uniqueness of the lifts prove their naturality.

The pair [m,a] is [m,1][1,a] in the quotient, so its image under η is i(m)η([1,a]). Every structural map f sends η([1,a]) to jK(a), by the prescribed structural image and uniqueness of the unit lift. Consequently any structural f with fi=v satisfies the pair formula fη([m,a])=v(m)jK(a).

For compatible v define b(U)(m,a)=v(U)(m)jK(U)(a), using the coproduct monoid homomorphism. If γ(m)=a, the unique lift of a gives v(m)=jK(a). Therefore each generator ((m,1),(1,a)) of divisorialChartCongruence belongs to the kernel of b(U). Apply Con.conGen_le and Con.lift to construct w(U) on the quotient. Naturality follows from naturality of v and jK. The assumed hsh for K gives a unique extension f with fη=w; its restriction along i is v.

Let O be the multiplicative étale structure sheaf. Its sheaf witness is Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf applied to the adopted source theorem Scheme.isSheaf_etaleStructurePresheaf, using that forget₂ CommRingCat CommMonCat is a right adjoint (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Ring.Adjunctions). Apply the assumed hsh to O and the natural quotient maps α_Lη. Both α_Kf and α_L have the same values on pairs by hα, compatibility of v and the structural formula for jK. Con.mk'_surjective extends this equality to all quotient elements. The uniqueness part of hsh now proves α_Kf=α_L.

Any other structural extension with restriction v has the same pair formula established above. Quotient surjectivity and the uniqueness part of hsh give equality with f. This proves the unique-extension clause. The already proved pair formula and preservation of the unit inclusions give the last two clauses.
